sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Personal Wealth Analytics and Investment Tracking Cloud

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Primarily governed by Law 526 of 1999 (creating the Financial Information and Analysis Unit, UIAF), Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT regime and criminalization of money laundering), Law 1762 of 2015 (corruption and organized crime), Law 2069 of 2020 and implementing Decree 830 of 2021 (mandatory Ultimate Beneficial Owner reporting to DIAN), and Superintendency of Companies External Circular 2020-11 (SAGRILAFT implementation for supervised entities).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of the foreign shareholder's certificate of existence and legal representation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home country company registry / chamber of commerce

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized and apostilled copy of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner's passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary in the country of issuance
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization when apostille is not recognized

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney granted for the S.A.S. incorporation representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Colombian consulate abroad or home country notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming source of funds for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing financial institution in the client's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Detailed UBO declaration and shareholding ownership chart
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Prospective legal representative / incorporator of the S.A.S.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against Colombian UIAF lists and Superintendency of Companies risk lists, OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, EU consolidated sanctions list, and domestic PEP databases. Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons under Law 1121 of 2006 and SAGRILAFT. Screening must be performed before incorporation and repeated on an ongoing event-based basis.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) online name reservation module through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) portal and the Ventanilla Única Empresarial (VUE) system
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be entered in Spanish script. Latin-script foreign words may be retained if they are used as a geographic or descriptive brand element and the remaining name is transliterated into Spanish alphabetical characters. Names must end with the corporate type indicator 'S.A.S.' and must not be identical, evocative, or confusingly similar to any previously registered name in the same activity class.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant must file a recurso de reposición with the same Chamber of Commerce within ten (10) business days of the rejection decision. A further recurso de apelación may be lodged before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) within five (5) business days after the Chamber's decision. The appeal must attach the original rejection notice, a revised proposed name, and reasoned legal justifications. A fresh name reservation filing is required if the initial 30-day window expires without successful incorporation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Accepted for S.A.S. companies providing software and IT services, provided that a physical mailing address for receiving official notifications and a local legal agent for procedural purposes are designated in the registration. The virtual office provider must be a registered and duly identified commercial entity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; approximately 3% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the Superintendency of Companies or DIAN for a standard low-risk fintech portfolio-tracking software entity.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and reservation fee at the local Chamber of Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff fixed by the Superintendency of Industry and Commerce (SIC) based on asset size

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and notarization of foreign corporate documents and UBO identification bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and foreign competent academies / notary offices
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory consular tariff plus prevailing market notary fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT legal due diligence, UBO piercing, PEP and sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External Colombian corporate and AML legal counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fixed fee for a standard S.A.S. incorporation with low-risk AML profile

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preparation of S.A.S. bylaws and notarial incorporation instrument
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External legal counsel and notary when public deed is required
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fixed fee for a standard S.A.S. incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Incorporation registration and filing at the Cámara de Comercio
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio de la sede principal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff published by the SIC, based on registered capital and number of employees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) preliminary report preparation and electronic filing with DIAN
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fixed fee for UBO report drafting; DEC filing itself is free

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Post-incorporation certificate of existence and legal representation from the Chamber of Commerce

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Arts. 1, 4, 5, 17, 45; Código de Comercio (Decreto-Ley 410 de 1971), Arts. 19, 110, 354, 372; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, Book II, Arts. 2.2.2.1.1 et seq. (commercial registry); Ley 2069 de 2020 (minimum-capital liberalization and fast-track registration); Estatuto Tributario (DIAN), Arts. 555-2 et seq. for RUT/NIT.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (CCB) — Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES), regulated and supervised by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC), coordinated with DIAN for the NIT/RUT pre-assignment.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución de Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (private incorporation instrument), optionally elevated to Escritura Pública if real property is contributed; submitted via the RUES electronic form 'Registro de sociedades'.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum subscribed capital for the S.A.S.; Ley 2069 de 2020 removed the former one-minimum-wage floor. The paid-in portion must be effectively deposited in a Colombian 'cuenta de constitución' opened in the provisional name of the company, and the issuing bank must grant a deposit certificate proving payment for the Cámara de Comercio. Any unpaid balance of subscribed capital must be settled within two (2) years from execution per Art. 4, Ley 1258 de 2008. No escrow account or trust is mandated by Colombian law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE INCORPORATING SHAREHOLDER(S) OF CO_SAS — First Meeting, [date]. ONE: The subscribed capital is approved and taken up in full under Article 4, Law 1258 of 2008; the paid-in portion, certified by the issuing bank, is recognized, and the balance shall be paid within the statutory two-year term. TWO: The registered domicile (domicilio social) is adopted at [principal address], Bogotá D.C., Colombia, and may be relocated by the Legal Representative within permitted rules. THREE: Ms./Mr. [Name], identified by document [ID No.], is appointed Legal Representative and General Manager, vested with the widest powers of representation, contract, banking, and labor administration; he/she is expressly authorized to execute all filings before the Cámara de Comercio, DIAN, and ancillary entities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name availability search and reservation of the corporate name (Pre-verificación y reserva de razón social)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RUES electronic portal (www.rues.org.co) or the Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá virtual office 'Trámites en Línea'.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an online request containing up to three alternative corporate names. The system verifies the national register and certifies availability; upon payment of the tariff, a name-reservation certificate valid for 30 calendar days is issued and must be presented to the Cámara de Comercio at the final registration step.
required_dossiers: Digital cédula of the filing shareholder
Application form 'Pre-aprobación de nombre'
Valid email and payment method for the virtual tariff
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected for identity or confusing similarity with an existing registered name, the applicant immediately files the next reserved alternative without loss of priority; if the applicant disputes the refusal, a written appeal may be lodged before the SIC within 10 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and notarial authentication of the incorporation document (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporating shareholders and their counsel; Notaría Pública only when a real-estate contribution exists, so the private document is elevated to Escritura Pública.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the bylaws including shareholder identification, corporate name, domicile, object (ISIC 6201 software and fintech portfolio-tracking cloud services), authorized, subscribed and paid-in capital, classes of shares, governance and representation clauses, dispute-resolution mechanisms, and fiscal year ending December 31. Execute the document; if real property is contributed, execute Escritura Pública before the chosen Notary and take the first certified copy for registration.
required_dossiers: Name-reservation certificate
Valid cédula or passport of each shareholder (non-residents may present passport and validate foreign document)
RUT or cédula of the legal representative
Final draft of the bylaws
If applicable, title deed and cadastral certificate for real-property contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial objections are cured by supplementing the missing documents and re-executing the deed; in private form, a corrected and re-executed incorporation document supersedes the defective draft with retroactive effect among the shareholders.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: DIAN NIT pre-assignment and opening of the provisional capital-deposit bank account (Pre-RUT y cuenta de constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Portal Muisca / RUT pre-inscription) in coordination with the selected Colombian credit institution (e.g., Bancolombia, Banco de Bogotá, Davivienda).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the incorporation data to DIAN, directly or through the CCB, to obtain the provisional NIT assigned to 'CO_SAS en constitución'. Present the pre-NIT and the draft bylaws to the bank and open a 'cuenta de constitución' in the company's provisional name; deposit the paid-in capital and request a 'Certificado de Consignación de Capital' issued expressly for the Cámara de Comercio registration.
required_dossiers: Draft incorporation document signed by the shareholders
Pre-NIT certificate (pre-RUT confirmation)
Cédula or passport of the legal representative
Beneficial-owner declaration (UBO) and anti-money-laundering form per Circular Básica Jurídica of the SIC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional UBO documentation, deliver the corporate hierarchy chart and sworn declaration; if the deposit certificate contains an error, the bank issues a correction letter within one working day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial registration and matrícula mercantil before the Cámara de Comercio (RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Mercantile Registry desk (physical or virtual RR service).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File at the CCB the executed incorporation instrument, the name-reservation certificate, the bank capital-deposit certificate, and the RUES registration forms. Pay the registration tariff online (PSE). The Chamber qualifies the document, records the incorporation in the Registro Mercantil, issues the certificate of existence and representation, and grants the matrícula mercantil of the company, simultaneously activating the definitive RUT request.
required_dossiers: Original and copy of the Documento Privado de Constitución or first notarial copy
Name-reservation certificate
Bank certificate of deposit of the paid-in capital
Pre-RUT certificate
RUES single registration form
Payment receipt of the registry tariff
Letter of authorization of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues a devolution order (auto de devolución), correct the specified observations and re-submit within the granted term (typically 10 working days) without new formalities; if the rejection arises from a name conflict, execute a shareholder ratification document adjusting the name and re-file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive RUT activation at DIAN and authorization of commercial accounting books
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN — Dirección Seccional of the domicile; accounting books authorized and stamped electronically by the Cámara de Comercio.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the certificate of incorporation, finalize the RUT in the DIAN portal (Muisca) to obtain the definitive NIT and the income-tax-and-consumer classification (Régimen Ordinario). Request electronic authorization for the company's statutory books: shareholders' register, assembly/board minutes, inventory and balance books, journal and ledger; if the company reaches the legal thresholds, include the fiscal-auditor book.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation issued by the CCB
Pre-RUT confirmation
Cédula or digital signature (certificado de firma digital) of the legal representative
RUT application if not automatically activated
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN corrects or rejects the RUT application for data-entry errors, rectify the affected fields online in the Muisca portal and re-submit within one business day; book-stamping objections are resolved by re-presenting the physical or electronic book form to the CCB.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration ancillary filings: employer social-security registration (PILA/ARL) and legal-representative signature certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: UGPP/PILA platform, Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL), and Cámara de Comercio for signature certification.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: When hiring begins, register the company as an employer in the PILA system for health and pension contributions and execute the ARL affiliation contract together with the SG-SST occupational safety and health program. Obtain the 'Certificado de Firma del Representante Legal' from the CCB to open the definitive operating bank account and to bind the company in contracts with Stripe and Apple IAP and local service providers.
required_dossiers: Definitive RUT and certificate of existence and legal representation
Act of acceptance of the legal representative
Payment form for the CCB signature-certification service
Initial payroll data of first employees, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the PILA employer registration is rejected due to mismatched social-security data, reconcile the payroll information with the EPS and pension administrator before re-submission; signature-certificate errors are corrected by reverifying the representative's identification document at the CCB.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for commercial-registry supervision, consumer protection, and personal-data processing registration (Ley 1581 de 2012); municipal Planning Office (e.g., Secretaría Distrital de Planeación in Bogotá) for the land-use compatibility certificate. No sectoral industrial licensing body applies to ISIC 6201 software and cloud services.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — Colombian law imposes no sectoral operating or manufacturing permit on pure software programming, financial portfolio-tracking platforms, or SaaS activities (ISIC 6201). The company operates under the CCB mercantile registration, the DIAN RUT, and the municipal certificate of compatible land use (uso de suelo) for its office premises.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Agencia Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA); for municipal-level projects or offices with installed machinery, the regional Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR Cundinamarca).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category III (administrative/service micro-activity with no pollutant-discharge installations) under Decreto 1076 de 2015, Title II, Chapter 3, Art. 2.2.2.3.2.1. No EIA request, environmental license, or environmental registration is required for the software/cloud operation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for serverless and cloud operations; the Bogotá office remains subject to municipal wastewater limits (Resolución 631 de 2015: pH 6.0–9.0, DQO 800 mg/L, SST 400 mg/L, oil and grease 40 mg/L), and if an emergency diesel generator is installed, to air-quality emission limits of Resolución 909 de 2008 and Resolución 2254 de 2017. E-waste from computers and batteries must be handed to licensed recyclers under Resolución 1407 de 2018.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification of the office leased premises by the Cuerpo de Bomberos (Bogotá) for occupancy loads above the applicable threshold; structural-load compliance with NSR-10, Title I for the rented office; and workplace-clearance program SG-SST (Decree 1072 de 2015, Book II, Chapter 2.2.4) filed with the ARL, including emergency evacuation plans and occupational-illness prevention for staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — Official portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional platform: MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado); e-services via DIAN's Habilitación and facturación electrónica web services.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The SAS must obtain a Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT) at incorporation. Foreign-owned entities: (1) Execute public deed before a Colombian notary appointing a legal representative resident in Colombia; (2) File the registration in the Cámara de Comercio (Commercial Registry) for the SAS, obtaining the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal; (3) Complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) form via MUISCA online portal or at DIAN service point, submitting the certificate of existence, statutes, and representative's identity documents (validated passport if foreign); (4) Obtain the digital signature certificate (Certificado Digital) issued by an authorized certification authority (e.g., DIAN's own or GSE) for e-invoicing and MUISCA filings; (5) Activate the NIT and confirm the VAT (IVA) and Income Tax (Impuesto sobre la Renta) obligations assigned; (6) Register the establishment in the DIAN's electronic invoicing system (Resolution 000165 of 2023 framework). Timeline: 7–20 business days for full activation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists in Colombia. Default: SAS is treated as a resident corporation (sociedad nacional) subject to entity-level corporate income tax at 35% (FY 2024), plus applicable surtax (3% for certain industries, not applicable to software). Available elections/regimes: (a) Tax consolidation (Régimen de Grupos Empresariales) after a 5-year prior authorization by DIAN for qualifying parent-subsidiary groups; (b) Simple regime of taxation (Régimen Simple de Tributación – SIMPLE) for small entities meeting revenue thresholds, optional election | not recommended for IVA exports); (c) Optional VAT refund offset mechanism for exporters via the 'ZEE' and free-trade zone regimes where applying for a free trade zone (Zona Franca US) permits a reduced 20% corporate income tax rate on industrial activities, subject to job creation thresholds (not typical for pure software); (d) Transfer pricing safe harbor elections and APA filings under Articles 260-1 to 260-11 E.T.; (e) Annual inflation adjustment elections for inventory costing methods. Hybrid mismatch rules follow OECD BEPS Action 2 via Law 2277/2022, limiting deductions for payments treated as hybrid instruments; no discrete election, mandatory compliance.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (IVA – Impuesto sobre las Ventas) under Estatuto Tributario Articles 420–524; national single-rate system with territorial consumption taxes limited to alcoholic beverages and gambling (not applicable to software); no provincial sales tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For legal entities (SAS), IVA registration via RUT is mandatory from the first taxable transaction, without a minimum economic threshold. For natural persons and other simplified regimes, the obligation triggers when gross income from taxable activities exceeds 3,500 UVTs (Unidad de Valor Tributario = COP 47,065 for FY 2024), i.e., COP 164,727,500, or when holding inventory as of December 31 above 5,000 UVTs (COP 235,325,000). For SAS incorporated as a company, NIT and IVA registration are concurrent at formation regardless of anticipated turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory since 2019 for all DIAN-required taxpayers. Under Resolución DIAN 000165 of November 2023 (effective January 2024), e-invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta – FEV) must: (1) use the 'Facturación Electrónica' platform with real-time DIAN validation via web services or the free mobile/desktop application 'DIAN Radian/FEV'; (2) incorporate a Unique Electronic Invoicing Code (CUFE) or CUDS (for savings/consignment) generated algorithmically from the invoice issuance range pre-authorized by DIAN; (3) transmit each invoice within 5 calendar days of issuance (before the 5th day after issuance); (4) obtain an authorized digital signature certificate (IRT – firma electrónica) for the computing platform; (5) send the final validation message containing the CUFE and the QR code onto the invoice PDF. For SaaS transactions, each monthly subscription or charge requires a FEV. Non-compliance fines under Article 652-13 E.T. (up to 5,000 UVTs per invoice irregularity) and initiatives to disable the NIT apply.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of services qualifies for 0% IVA rate under Article 481(e) E.T. and Decree 1805 of 2010, provided the service: (a) is rendered directly to a foreign beneficiary domiciled outside Colombia; (b) is 'exported' — the real use or effect of the service must occur abroad (criterion of use and enjoyment); (c) is rendered by the Colombian company without a substantive nexus in Colombia; (d) the export is evidenced by a service contract and invoices issued to the non-resident party; (e) foreign currency payments are received through the Colombian official foreign exchange market (exceptions permitted for non-residents' deposits in local accounts). Software-as-a-Service insight dashboards, cloud portfolio tracking, and data analytics for non-resident financial clients fall under the 'technology and software' service category eligible for zero-rating if the technical assistance or the digital service is consumed outside Colombia (Título 1.6 Decreto 1625/2016, arts. 1.6.1.13.15-1.6.1.13.22).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación de Servicios (export service declaration form filed via MUISCA, encoded as Formulario 630 — 'Información de Exportaciones de Servicios')
Commercial service contract executed with the non-resident client specifying the service scope, destination of use, and pricing
FEV (Electronic Invoice) issued to the foreign client with CUFE code
Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document (only if physical goods are peripherally included; for pure software, digital delivery proof)
Certificado de Movimiento de Divisas / Declaración de Cambio (foreign exchange certificate from the Colombian intermediary bank evidencing wire receipt from the non-resident)
Proof of payment rails settlement (Stripe/Apple IAP must route through a Colombian FX intermediary to comply with Decree 1074/2015 exchange regime)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN and the National Customs Authority (part of DIAN) actively scrutinize 'export of services' zero-rating claims. Typical audit triggers: recurring losses, exceptionally high export returns, unregistered accrued services, or FX settlement outside the mandatory 6-month term. Legal consequences: (a) if the documentary bundle is incomplete or the use-and-enjoyment criterion is not met, the invoice becomes a nonexempt sale taxed at 19% IVA, DIAN issues additional tax assessments (período gravable) plus daily default interest (interest at twice the legal lending rate, art. 635 E.T.); (b) 'sanción por inexactitud' under Article 647 E.T. — 200% of the difference between the improperly zero-rated tax and the correct assessment (increased to 500% when the false export is initiated for evasion); (c) fines under Article 652-13 E.T. for falsely claiming export exclusions (up to 20,000 UVTs ≈ COP 941.3 million for FY 2024 per base period); (d) criminal liability under Article 402 Código Penal for 'Fraudulent Exportation' — imprisonment of 6 to 12 years and asset seizure when export declarations are false; (e) retrospective clawback comprising the unpaid IVA plus penalties for all prior VAT returns within the 5-year window (statute of limitations art. 714 E.T. — 3 years in some cases for returns, but DIAN may extend to 5 years in the presence of formal faults).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia) is the sole foreign-exchange authority under Decree 1735 of 1993 and the current Régimen Cambiario; the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) supervises authorized exchange-market intermediaries (commercial banks and financial corporations), and DIAN enforces export documentation and customs formalities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renewal of Mercantile Registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce, e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal imposes monthly chamber tariff surcharges; persistent omission allows the Chamber to cancel the mercantile registration and remove the company's commercial legal standing until renewal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form 110 – Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually; 2025 due dates from 7 February to 17 April based on the last digit of the NIT; DIAN publishes a new schedule each year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% of the tax assessed for each month or fraction of delay, default interest, and administrative fines; persistent non-compliance may trigger collection enforcement and business suspension measures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of Annual Financial Statements and Shareholders' Meeting Minutes (Estados Financieros + Actas de Asamblea)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval by the shareholders' meeting and no later than 31 March for standard calendar-year companies when the annual meeting is held early in the year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late deposit incurs Chamber registration penalties and adverse registry records; repeated failure may lead to cancellation of merchant registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Exogenous Tax Information Report (Información Exógena)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the date fixed by DIAN resolution, normally between the second and third quarter following the tax year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to COP 333,500 per set of incorrect or omitted records and 1%–5% of the improperly reported values; can raise audit risk and lead to assessment proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Update (Actualización del Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually according to DIAN's RUT/beneficiario final calendar; any change in ownership affecting UBO percentage must be updated within 30 working days.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to update UBO data can result in DIAN administrative fines, invalid or blocked tax certificates, and increased anti-money-laundering scrutiny.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Colombian S.A.S. must appoint a 'revisor fiscal' (statutory auditor) if, in the preceding fiscal year, gross assets or gross revenues exceed 3,000 monthly legal minimum wages (SMMLV) – approximately COP 4,270 million for 2025; public-interest companies and entities subject to specific laws may need an auditor below this threshold.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian regulatory adoption of IFRS under Law 1314/2009 and Decree 2420/2015: Group 1 uses full IFRS, Group 2 uses IFRS for SMEs, and Group 3 uses simplified micro-entity accounting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must file and annually re-confirm ultimate beneficial owners through DIAN's 'Beneficiario Final' screen in the RUT platform. Any share transfer or control change that alters the UBO list must be registered in the shareholder register and reported to DIAN within 30 working days; the annual confirmation itself follows the DIAN calendar and must be completed even if no transfers occurred.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members / Shareholders (Libro de Socios/Accionistas)
Register of Directors and Board Minutes (Libro de Actas de la Junta Directiva, if applicable)
Minute Book of Shareholders' Meetings (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Socios/Accionistas)
Statutory Auditor's Book (Libro de Revisor Fiscal), only when a revisor fiscal is legally required

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No generally applicable CIT tax holiday remains for an S.A.S. under Law 2277/2022. Preferential deductions and credits available: (i) 25% additional deduction for investments in research, science, technology and innovation (Article 256-1 E.T.); (ii) VAT exemption/zero-rating on exported software services and related cloud hosting; (iii) tax credit for qualifying foreign-linked digital service exports; (iv) historical 'orange economy' reduced rate of 20% was eliminated and is no longer available for new taxpayers.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 'Declaración de Renta y Complementarios' via DIAN electronic portal (Sede Electrónica DIAN), using the annual Resolution fixing the filing schedule by last two digits of NIT.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Fiscal year is the calendar year. For non-large taxpayers the filing window is generally between 9 August and 17 September of the following tax year, determined by the last two digits of the NIT; Grandes Contribuyentes file in April/May.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report total gross SaaS subscription and financial-tracking software licensing revenue, including recurring cloud analytics fees, recognized on an accrual basis. Exclude VAT collected.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident-owned S.A.S., include all invoiced amounts to foreign and local clients; cross-border related-party invoicing must be disclosed in the transfer pricing annex and priced at arm's length.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 44 - Ingresos no constitutivos de renta (Non-taxable income)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Record only statutory exclusions such as corrections to previous-year income or reimbursements representing costs paid by customers, if properly documented.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Usually nil for SaaS; if a capital contribution or refund from a related party is incorrectly classified here, DIAN will recharacterize it as taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 45 - Costos de venta (Cost of sales)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs attributable to delivering the cloud platform: third-party cloud infrastructure, licensed data feeds, API connectivity charges, external sub-processors, and amortization of capitalized software development.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Costs paid to foreign related parties (e.g. hosting on a parent group server) must be supported by a valid transfer pricing method, executed contract, and evidence of actual services.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating deductions: salaries and social security of local engineers and support staff, lease and utilities of the service office, marketing expenses, professional fees, IT security compliance costs, and depreciation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions for intercompany royalty or management payments are allowed only if the additive requirements under Articles 124-2 and 631 E.T. are met and the Beneficial Owner/TRC is retained. Payments to blacklisted tax havens may be disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Claim only statutory exemptions, e.g. qualified software-export earnings if the taxpayer still holds a valid pre-2023 exemption regime; otherwise leave nil.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign shareholders cannot create an exemption where none is due; an unsubstantiated exemption triggers a 200% inexactness penalty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 62 - Impuesto de renta a cargo (CIT payable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compute tax at 35% of the taxable base after allowed loss carryforward and any R&D deductions, deduct prepayments and withholding tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders receiving dividends from after-tax profits must separately prepare the dividend withholding form; no shareholder-level expense is deductible in the S.A.S. return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 83 - Saldo a pagar o saldo a favor (Balance payable or carryover credit)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final net amount payable to the National Treasury after prepayments and credits; if negative, record refundable tax credit requested for cross-check with DIAN.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A carryover credit cannot be remitted abroad; a subsequent refund request may be slowed if the non-resident shareholding structure is not disclosed or the fiscal tax residency of the shareholder is unclear.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of tax due for each month or fraction of delay, capped at 100% of the tax due, with a minimum fine of 10 UVT when no tax is payable (Articles 641, 642 E.T.). Late payment interest accrues daily at the indexed monetary-correction rate. Inaccurate filing is additionally penalized under Article 647 with up to 200% of the understated tax.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% withholding tax on dividend distributions made from profits that have already been subject to the 35% CIT, applicable to non-resident corporate shareholders and resident individuals. For resident corporate shareholders, dividends are generally non-taxable. For non-resident individuals and non-resident companies without treaty protection, the 10% rate applies, with no exemption for the first 300 UVT (such de minimis exemption applies only to resident individuals under current rules).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke dividend withholding tax relief under an applicable DTA, the non-resident shareholder must: (1) obtain and deliver to the Colombian withholding agent a Certificate of Fiscal Residence (Certificado de Residencia Fiscal, TRC) issued by the country of residence before the effective payment date; (2) complete and submit the Payer Information Affidavit identifying the beneficial owner and demonstrating no flow-through; (3) document shareholding percentage and holding period to support a reduced rate (commonly 5% for qualifying shareholdings, 10% for portfolio); (4) retain the TRC and underlying transfer documents for at least five years for DIAN audit; (5) if the reduced rate is applied in error, a refund may be claimed via the DIAN electronic refund mechanism but carries audit risk.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on royalties for software/IP licences and on debt interest paid to non-resident payees: 15% general rate, increased to 20% in certain lender-related scenarios; treaty rates may reduce withholding to 0-10% for royalties and 0-10% for interest if the recipient is the beneficial owner and holds valid CRF.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: COP 135,000,000 (approx. USD 37,000) in aggregate related-party transactions in the fiscal year triggers the filing of Form 120 and the Local File. The Master File is additionally required when the worldwide group's consolidated revenue exceeds COP 30,000,000,000 or the local entity's related-party transactions surpass COP 5,000,000,000. All thresholds are annually adjusted by DIAN.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not apply a dedicated Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) regime, but economic substance is embedded in the general anti-avoidance rule (GAAR, Article 631 E.T.), the anti-abuse doctrine, and treaty-benefit realization analysis. A financial-tracking software S.A.S. must evidence real local decision-making, qualified engineering personnel, physical premises, active license/contract management, and a distinct function-asset-risk profile; otherwise DIAN may disregard the legal personality, recharacterize the S.A.S. as a permanent establishment of the foreign beneficial owner, or deny treaty benefits and intercompany deductions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Willful Understatement of Taxable Income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission of SaaS subscription revenue, artificial deferral of recognized licensing income, or booking of fictitious costs related to 'financial portfolio tracking' algorithms and cloud infrastructure expenses with no supporting evidence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax evasion is punishable under Law 2277/2022 by imprisonment of 3 to 12 years where the evaded tax exceeds 250 UVT. The tax administration simultaneously imposes an inexactness penalty of 200% of the understated tax (Article 647 E.T.), daily late-payment interest, and disallowance of all claimed loss carryforwards.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives are jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax debt if the understatement results from wilful misconduct; criminal prosecution may include civil restitution of evaded amounts, freezing of personal bank accounts, a travel ban, and imprisonment of the responsible officers.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Sham S.A.S. Without Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a formally registered non-resident-owned S.A.S. with no employees, no local office, no operational data servers, and no local board activity in Colombia, used solely to channel foreign fintech revenue or to obtain lower effective taxation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may apply the corporate veil-piercing doctrine under Article 16 of the Colombian Commercial Code and Article 631 E.T., declaring the S.A.S. non-existent for tax purposes; all income is reattributed to the foreign principal, with tax recalculated at 35%, plus penalties of 200% and interest; the commercial registry may be cancelled and the entity liquidated.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The limited liability shield is removed: directors and shareholders become personally liable for the full tax deficiency and accrued interest; personal assets are embargoed, travel bans are issued by the DIAN collection department, and continuing operation as a sham entity can support fraud charges carrying imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Documentation Failure and Non-Arm's-Length Intercompany Pricing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file Form 120, Local File, or Master File when related-party transactions exceed the threshold, or charging foreign affiliates a 30% gross margin for software development and portfolio-tracking data analytics without a comparability study or economic substantiation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Unfiled or late transfer pricing documentation triggers fines of up to 1% of the aggregate related-party transaction value per document (Article 634 E.T.); DIAN will adjust the taxable income to arm's length, apply a 10% surcharge on the adjustment, and add daily default interest; total assessment may exceed 300% of the underpaid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or approve intercompany agreements may be declared jointly liable for the resulting tax deficiency if they knew or should have known of the disconnected pricing; the director's personal residence and shareholder equity can be attached, and a court may issue a prohibition against leaving the country pending payment of the aggregate tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Abusive Cross-Border Profit Repatriation and Unsubstantiated Treaty Relief
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing dividends out of after-tax profits to a non-resident shareholder resident in a zero-tax jurisdiction without a certificate of fiscal residence, or paying high management fees to an offshore affiliate in a blacklisted jurisdiction in order to strip the local S.A.S. of taxable income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Withholding tax is recharged at the statutory 10% dividend rate or 15%/20% interest-royalty rate plus penalty; the deduction for the payment is denied as a prohibited cost in tax havens; the taxpayer faces the full 200% inexactness penalty and failure-to-withhold surcharge; a criminal complaint for illicit tax conduct may be filed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for the withheld tax not collected and remitted to DIAN; civil restitution includes personal fund recovery of the unpaid foreign payments; the judicial process may impose a property embargo, a travel ban, and imprisonment for up to 10 years where the artificial profit extraction is characterized as aggravated tax evasion.
